answer: Funding-source tracing: every new agent's first tokens arrive through some inlet, and the protocol traces that deposit back up the transfer graph. Accounts whose funding fans out from one wallet like a river delta are grouped and share a single reward allotment, as if they were one agent. To dodge this, an attacker must fund each fake from its own independent harbor of capital, such as separate exchange withdrawals with real fees and verification, so splitting one wallet across a thousand clones stops paying.
